claims.claim: On March 5, 2026 the Canadian Nuclear Safety Commission approved NexGen's federal Environmental Assessment and issued the Licence to Prepare Site and Construct for the 100%-owned Rook I uranium project.
NexGen states this federal licence followed provincial EA approval and other provincial authorizations and represents the final regulatory approval required to initiate full construction.

NexGen also formed a partnership with Clearwater River Dene Nation and Métis Nation-Saskatchewan Local 39 for a 59-room La Loche hotel intended to support regional demand associated with Rook I construction and operations.

factors.name: regulatory de-risking
factors.basis: Receipt of the construction licence converts a major permitting uncertainty into an executable project pathway.

factors.name: regional infrastructure readiness
factors.basis: Community-linked accommodation investment is consistent with preparation for a construction workforce and longer-lived local activity.

risks.risk: A permitted mine remains exposed to construction, financing, schedule, cost, uranium-price and commissioning risk before production.

unknowns.unknown: This evidence does not establish current construction percentage completion, final capital cost or production start date.

claims.claim: Rook I crossed its final stated federal regulatory gate in March 2026, shifting the central execution question from permission to construction delivery.

The La Loche hotel is targeted for operation in July 2027 and structured for eventual full community ownership and operation, while NexGen says it is maintaining focus on the Rook I construction ramp.

factors.name: milestone conversion
factors.basis: Federal licensing is a hard external milestone rather than management-only guidance.

factors.name: construction conversion risk
factors.basis: Regulatory approval enables construction but does not prove on-budget/on-time mine delivery.

risks.risk: Mine development has long lead times and can suffer inflation, contractor, workforce, infrastructure and commissioning slippage.

unknowns.unknown: No Scout claim is made about project NPV, uranium-price assumptions or security valuation.
